newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends stable ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends stable ahead of holiday.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed little changed against its American counterpart in light trade on Monday ahead of a national holiday on Tuesday, dealers said.
The local dollar ended at T$27.495, against Saturday's T$27.492 close. Turnover through dealers was a slow US$120.5 million.
"Tuesday is a holiday and the Singapore and New York markets are closed on Monday, so making players little interest to open positions," said one dealer.
"If the domestic economy really begins recovering, the Taiwan dollar may rise to reverse previous forecast," she said. "But for near term, a narrow-range consolidation is most likely."
The market will be closed on Tuesday for holiday.
For Wednesday, a T$27.485-27.500 range was seen.
